correctness.rationale: For every n>=3 and each single conjugacy class of B_n, Schur orthogonality is normalized by a sqrt(n) linear isometry. Under conjugation, End(C^n) decomposes multiplicity-free into 1, n-1, n(n-1)/2, n(n-1)/2 sectors. Projection energies of an orbit representative are s^2/n, f-s^2/n, (n-f)/2+tau, (n-f)/2-tau, derived from actual signed entries and two-cycle products and summing exactly to n. Orbit averaging gives all displayed eigenvalues with multiplicities. The trace n^2|C|/|B_n| forces scalar tightness value w; solving sector equations proves f=1,tau=0 exactly. Positive sectors yield injectivity criterion. The extracted standard-library checker computes complete integer orbit operators on all n^2 matrix directions for all 66 classes in n=3,4,5, including all boundaries. Finite checks corroborate rather than replace the proof.

value.rationale: Exact Fourier recovery and condition numbers from conjugacy classes are natural finite nonabelian harmonic invariants. The theorem exhausts all signed cycle types in every n>=3, produces a necessary-and-sufficient class recovery condition, and classifies infinitely many exactly tight, single-class sampling frames starting at rank 4. The sign of 2-cycles separates symmetric and alternating matrix sectors, a structural effect not described by unsigned fixed-point counts. It is a motivated complete classification, not an arbitrary slice, small table extension, or mere parameter substitution.
